HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the House and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
